On the process/organization interface (p5), the slice shows continuity of the leadership installed at closing (Jackson CEO, Kevin Knight Executive Chairman, Miller CFO) as of Feb 2021 and no documented fracture between operations and people/management/culture — hence 0. Improving net income ($309mm to $410mm), improving operating ratio (91.2% to 87.9%), and no goodwill impairment or divestiture within the window indicate no realized disruption on these interfaces. The controlling-intent archetype (t1) is coded uncertain because the accounting-acquirer/legal-acquirer split (Knight designated Accounting Acquirer, Swift the legal acquirer) is noted but the slice does not document how the announced controlling intent played out as one-sided dominance or coherent equality.
